plain_statement: A graph in which every vertex outside a set A has exactly three neighbours, A meets no edge, every cycle has length at least 7, and there is an edge; f is true when some input of A is on or both ends of an edge are on. For a vertex v outside A, let G' be the graph with the edges at v removed and f' the same function for G' and A. If every vertex cover of G' has at least t vertices, every circuit of AND, OR (two-input) and NOT gates for f' has at least |A| + (edges of G') + t - 1 gates.
